title: Institutional Representation Research: Paper 2 code and frozen evidence
description: Reproducibility release for Who May Overrule the Agent? Evidence-Gated Authority in LLM Review Institutions (arXiv:2611.05390). Includes the submitted manuscript, executable experiment and analysis code, frozen processed results and raw model outputs for Qwen3-8B and Mistral-Small-24B. Based on September submission commit 63cbef41bfe2fa3150d06c47e622faa826880ab3; only README and citation/archive metadata changed. Excludes later Paper 3 work. Paper 1 remains reproducible at v1.0.2 and DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22119501.
